description: Defines a utility class 'HeaderValueValidators' that provides various static methods to obtain validator instances for different header value types in the Eclipse Ditto project. These validators include checks for non-empty strings, integers, longs, booleans, JSON objects/arrays, entity tags, durations, timeouts, metadata headers, and acknowledgement labels. The class is designed to facilitate validation chaining for header value handling.

classes.name: HeaderValueValidators
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to obtain validators for various header value types in the Ditto project.

methods.name: getNoOpValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator that never throws an exception, effectively accepting any value.

methods.name: getNonEmptyValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator that checks if a CharSequence is non-empty.

methods.name: getIntValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator that checks if a CharSequence can be parsed as an integer.

methods.name: getLongValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator that checks if a CharSequence can be parsed as a long.

methods.name: getBooleanValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator that checks if a CharSequence is a boolean value.

methods.name: getJsonArrayValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator that checks if a CharSequence represents a JSON array with string items.

methods.name: getJsonObjectValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator that checks if a CharSequence represents a JSON object.

methods.name: getEntityTagValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator for EntityTag validity.

methods.name: getEntityTagMatcherValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator for EntityTagMatcher validity.

methods.name: getEntityTagMatchersValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator for comma-separated list of EntityTagMatchers.

methods.name: getRequestedAcksValueValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator for JSON array of acknowledgement labels.

methods.name: getDittoDurationValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator for DittoDuration representations.

methods.name: getTimeoutValueValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator for timeout values represented as DittoDuration.

methods.name: getMetadataHeadersValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator for MetadataHeaders instances.
